PTR-CMP-C1.name: Proscenium stage
PTR-CMP-C1.layers: ground, far, middle, near set, figures, props, lyric card, proscenium frame
PTR-CMP-C1.safe_area: Lyric inside the arch opening's central 80%.
PTR-CMP-C1.assets: All SIL sets, FIG, FRM arches, TYP cards

PTR-CMP-C2.name: Window stage
PTR-CMP-C2.layers: window set (ground, far, mid), window frame, wall, sill props, lyric
PTR-CMP-C2.assets: FRM windows, any set, PRP sill props

PTR-CMP-C3.name: Pop-up book
PTR-CMP-C3.layers: table, book pages, pop-up pieces in 3 fold planes, page text
PTR-CMP-C3.assets: FRM book spread, SIL sets, TYP printed page

PTR-CMP-C4.name: Lantern
PTR-CMP-C4.layers: darkness, disc ground, disc set (2-3 layers), ring text or card
PTR-CMP-C4.safe_area: Ring text inside the frame with 6% margin; card below disc.
PTR-CMP-C4.assets: FRM lantern ring, any set (reduced), FIG

PTR-CMP-C5.name: Panorama scroll
PTR-CMP-C5.layers: ground, strip far, strip near, rollers frame, banner
PTR-CMP-C5.assets: SIL sets with seam pieces, TRN sets, FRM rollers

PTR-CMP-C6.name: Close-up cut
PTR-CMP-C6.layers: ground, large piece with letter holes
PTR-CMP-C6.safe_area: Letters inside the piece and the central 80%.
PTR-CMP-C6.assets: PRP large pieces, TYP cut letters

PTR-CMP-C7.name: Tiny stage in the dark
PTR-CMP-C7.layers: darkness, mini stage (all layers scaled), card
PTR-CMP-C7.assets: Any set at reduced detail, FRM small arch

PTR-SIL-CTY.name: City pieces
PTR-SIL-CTY.compatible_with: Other pieces of the same set; figures; frames; props of the same season.
PTR-SIL-CTY.exclusions: Never two sets in one stage (except the panorama, which joins neighbouring sets at a declared seam piece); no piece larger than 40% of the frame except near-frame pieces.

PTR-LGT-LGT.exclusions: Gel cycle only fairground and high energy.

PTR-TYP-TYP.name: Lyric treatments
PTR-TYP-TYP.exclusions: Cut letters only for lines of 3 words or fewer (Latin) or one word (complex scripts, per width rule).

PTR-MOT-MOT.name: Choreographies
PTR-MOT-MOT.compatible_with: Figures and pieces with pivots or rails.
PTR-MOT-MOT.exclusions: No choreography crosses the lyric box during a reveal.

PTR-PRP-PRP.name: Props and large pieces
PTR-PRP-PRP.compatible_with: Seasonal matching (snow with winter sets only).

layer_order: post: paper fibre on ground, fog on far layers

invalid.because: Breaks the world (only panorama seams join sets).
Becomes unreadable; use a printed card.

limits.scale: Far pieces 10-30% of height, middle 20-45%, near 30-60%; figures 8-25%; no piece over 40% except frames and C6.
limits.safe: Lyric on the brightest ground region and inside the frame opening's central 80%; no piece may cover more than 8% of the lyric box (overlap test).
limits.complexity: Max 20 pieces on stage; max 7 layers.
limits.colour: One ground hue per stage; one tissue accent; pieces black or set paper only.
limits.motion: Max 3 moving elements (intensity tier caps); no piece crosses the lyric box while a word is being revealed.
limits.material: Tissue only for light-transmitting pieces; tracing paper only on the far layer; kraft and black card never on the same layer.
